text:
tara: Quick heads up — in prod we saw quota and billing attributed to the impersonating project when requests go through SA impersonation + project fallback. Trace id 01F8ABCD... :eyes:
sam: Repro steps?
tara: 1) Client key from org-A calls endpoint with project header missing. 2) Auth proxy falls back to SA's default project (proj-B) during impersonation. 3) Request executes; billing attribution shows proj-B.
sam: Sounds like we currently set `effective_project = impersonated_project` in the proxy. We should keep two fields: `origin_project` (who requested) and `effective_project` (who executed). Right now `origin_project` gets overwritten.
leo: Console UX ask: show a small breadcrumb next to billing/quotas: "Requested by proj-A (via sa-dataflow)" with a tooltip that expands the origin chain. Users get confused when the billed project != their project.
anya: Telemetry thoughts: emit `auth.impersonation.hop_count` and an `auth.origin_chain` tag. Also sample and attach `redwood.origin_chain` to traces for 1% of requests to avoid cardinality explosion.
sam: Can we standardize an HTTP header for this so downstream services can consume it? e.g. `X-Redwood-Origin: org:123,proj:proj-A,sa:sa-x` and `X-Redwood-Effective-Project: proj-B`.
kevin: I can change the proxy to preserve `X-Redwood-Origin` and add `X-Redwood-Effective-Project`. Will also emit a counter `auth.billing.attribution_override` when origin_project != effective_project and a histogram `auth.impersonation.hops`.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: auth-proxy v2 -> 5% at 2025-06-03T10:00Z :rocket:
tara: Rollout plan: 5% for 24h, monitor `auth.impersonation.hop_count`, `auth.billing.attribution_override`, and billing alerts.
leo: Console change: add breadcrumb + tooltip "Origin chain" and a link to trace view. Will create a lightweight UI flag so we can toggle if noisy.
kevin: I'll open a PR with the header changes + metrics, will tag @leo and @tara. ETA EOD tomorrow.
product: FYI — heads up to sales/support that customers using SA impersonation may see attribution differences during rollout.
anya: Small note: sample origin_chain at 1% initially and backfill logs for any billing-mismatch alert hits. Avoid full retention for chain strings.
sam: Also add a short policy in the docs about which field drives quota vs billing vs observability so platform teams know what to expect.
tara: Decision summary: 1) Auth-proxy keeps origin vs effective fields and emits impersonation metrics; 2) Console shows requested-by breadcrumb and trace link; 3) Canary 5% for 24h; 4) Sample origin_chain 1% and add billing-mismatch alerting. Owners: kevin (auth), leo (console), tara (oncall).
kevin: I'll post the PR link here when ready.
tara: Thanks everyone :+1:
